brief:
Israeli police said they arrested eight settlers suspected of involvement in attacks on a European diplomatic mission and an American journalist in the West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported.

The detentions followed incidents targeting foreign officials and media personnel operating in occupied Palestinian territory. Police did not immediately disclose additional details about the circumstances of the arrests or the specific attacks under investigation.

title: Israeli police arrest eight settlers suspected in attacks on diplomats, journalist
